methodology_note: Post-unblinding exploratory development fixtures authored from frozen Day 4A security constructs; this set is neither the original holdout nor a new confirmatory holdout.
source_license_policy: Repository-authored synthetic fixtures distributed under the project MIT license; no third-party or private metadata is included.
description: Thirty-six independent construct-derived fixtures for exploratory P0 regression engineering, reported separately from the existing development corpus and exposed holdout.
